import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
const { chromium, webkit } = await import(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE);
const helpers = await import(pathToFileURL(path.resolve('src/pages/ContactPage/data/inquiry.js')));
const { photoRules } = await import(pathToFileURL(path.resolve('src/pages/ContactPage/data/contactData.js')));
const out = process.env.QA_OUTPUT;
await fs.mkdir(out, { recursive: true });
const report = { checks: [], failures: [], layouts: [], assets: [] };
const check = (message) => report.checks.push(message);
const empty = helpers.createInitialInquiry(null);
const valid = { ...empty, name: 'Alex Morgan', email: 'alex@example.com' };
assert.deepEqual(helpers.validateInquiry(valid), {});
assert.deepEqual(helpers.validateInquiry({ ...empty, name: 'Alex', phone: '(215) 555-0126' }), {});
assert(helpers.validateInquiry({ ...valid, name: '   ' }).name);
assert(helpers.validateInquiry({ ...empty, name: 'Alex' }).phone);
assert(helpers.validateInquiry({ ...valid, phone: 'abc' }).phone);
assert(helpers.validateInquiry({ ...valid, email: 'alex@' }).email);
assert(helpers.validateInquiry({ ...valid, zip: '12' }).zip);
assert.deepEqual(helpers.validateInquiry({ ...valid, zip: '19103-1234' }), {});
assert(helpers.validateInquiry({ ...valid, service: 'unknown' }).service);
assert(helpers.validateInquiry({ ...valid, message: 'x'.repeat(4001) }).message);
assert.equal(helpers.getInquiryContext({ articleTitle: {} }), null);
assert.equal(helpers.getInquiryContext({ projectTitle: 'X', projectId: 4 }).id, '');
check('Pure field validation: required and optional fields, limits, malformed source state');
const meta = (name, size = 1024, type = 'image/png') => ({ name, size, type, lastModified: 0 });
assert.equal(helpers.selectPhotos([], [meta('roof.png')]).files.length, 1);
assert.equal(helpers.selectPhotos([meta('roof.png')], [meta('roof.png')]).files.length, 1);
assert(helpers.selectPhotos([], [meta('bad.exe')]).error);
assert(helpers.selectPhotos([], [meta('bad.jpg', 4, 'text/plain')]).error);
assert(helpers.selectPhotos([], [meta('empty.png', 0)]).error);
assert(helpers.selectPhotos([], [meta('big.png', photoRules.maxBytes + 1)]).error);
assert(!helpers.selectPhotos([], [meta('limit.png', photoRules.maxBytes)]).error);
assert(helpers.selectPhotos([], Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, i) => meta(`file-${i}.png`))).error);
const existing = [meta('existing.png')];
assert.equal(helpers.selectPhotos(existing, [meta('ok.png'), meta('bad.txt')]).files, existing);
assert(!helpers.selectPhotos([], [meta('camera.JPG', 1, '')]).error);
check('Pure photo validation: duplicate, type, empty, size boundary, count and atomic rejection');

async function inspectAssets(dir) {
  for (const entry of await fs.readdir(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const file = path.join(dir, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) await inspectAssets(file);
    else if (file.endsWith('.svg')) {
      const content = await fs.readFile(file, 'utf8');
      assert(content.includes('</svg>'), `complete svg: ${file}`);
      const root = content.match(/<svg\b[^>]*>/)?.[0];
      report.assets.push({ file, bytes: Buffer.byteLength(content), root });
    }
  }
}
await inspectAssets('src/pages/ContactPage/components');
assert.equal(report.assets.length, 10);
check('Ten complete local SVGs; original root dimensions captured');

const base = 'http://127.0.0.1:4173';
async function ready(page, url = `${base}/contact`) {
  await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'networkidle' });
  await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
  await page.waitForFunction(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('.contact-page img')].every((img) => img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0));
}
const fileData = (name = 'roof.png', mimeType = 'image/png', size) => ({ name, mimeType, buffer: size ? Buffer.alloc(size) : Buffer.from('iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAQAAAC1HAwCAAAAC0lEQVR42mP8/x8AAwMCAO+jFioAAAAASUVORK5CYII=', 'base64') });

for (const [browserName, engine] of Object.entries({ chromium, webkit })) {
  const browser = await engine.launch();
  const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 } });
  const page = await context.newPage();
  const errors = [], submissions = [], external = [], demoLogs = [];
  page.on('pageerror', (error) => errors.push(String(error)));
  page.on('request', (req) => {
    if (req.method() === 'POST') submissions.push(req.url());
    if (!req.url().startsWith('http://127.0.0.1:') && !req.url().startsWith('data:')) external.push(req.url());
  });
  page.on('console', async (msg) => {
    if (msg.type() === 'log' && msg.text().startsWith('[Veldridge Contact demo')) {
      demoLogs.push(await msg.args()[1].jsonValue());
    }
  });
  try {
    for (const width of [320, 390, 700, 701, 900, 1100, 1101, 1280, 1440, 1920]) {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: width <= 700 ? 844 : 900 });
      await ready(page);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('h1').count(), 1);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('.inquiry-form form').count(), 1);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('#contact-service option').count(), 10);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('.contact-details a[href^="tel:"], .contact-details a[href^="mailto:"]').count(), 0, 'demo details are not live links');
      const layout = await page.evaluate(() => ({
        width: innerWidth, clientWidth: document.documentElement.clientWidth, scrollWidth: document.documentElement.scrollWidth,
        columns: getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.contact-page__columns')).gridTemplateColumns,
        form: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.inquiry-form').getBoundingClientRect(); return { width: b.width, x: b.x, height: b.height }; })(),
        overflow: [...document.querySelectorAll('.contact-page h1, .contact-page h2, .contact-details__information, .inquiry-form__control, .photo-picker__guidance, .contact-map__card')].filter((el) => el.scrollWidth > el.clientWidth + 2).map((el) => el.className),
      }));
      assert(layout.scrollWidth <= layout.clientWidth + 1, `page overflow at ${width}`);
      assert.deepEqual(layout.overflow, [], `text overflow at ${width}`);
      report.layouts.push({ browser: browserName, ...layout });
      if ([390, 900, 1440].includes(width)) await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(out, `${browserName}-contact-${width}.png`), fullPage: true });
      if (width === 1440) {
        assert(Math.abs(layout.form.width - 736) < 2, 'approved form width');
        assert(Math.abs(layout.form.x - 624) < 2, 'approved form position');
      }
      check(`${browserName}: responsive layout and local assets ${width}px`);
    }

    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 900 });
    await ready(page);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send Message', exact: true }).click();
    assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement.id), 'contact-name');
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.inquiry-form__error-summary').count(), 1);
    assert.equal(demoLogs.length, 0);
    await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(out, `${browserName}-validation.png`), fullPage: true });
    await page.getByLabel('Name *', { exact: true }).fill('Alex Morgan');
    await page.getByLabel('Email', { exact: true }).fill('bad@');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send Message', exact: true }).click();
    assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement.id), 'contact-email');
    await page.getByLabel('Email', { exact: true }).fill('alex@example.com');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send Message', exact: true }).click();
    await page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Demo complete.' }).waitFor();
    await page.waitForTimeout(100);
    assert.equal(demoLogs.length, 1);
    assert.equal(demoLogs[0].email, 'alex@example.com');
    assert.equal(demoLogs[0].phone, '');
    assert.deepEqual(demoLogs[0].photos, []);
    assert(await page.locator('.inquiry-form__result').evaluate((el) => el === document.activeElement));
    await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(out, `${browserName}-demo-result.png`), fullPage: true });
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Back to Form' }).click();
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.activeElement.id === 'contact-name');
    assert.equal(await page.locator('#contact-name').inputValue(), 'Alex Morgan');
    check(`${browserName}: validation, email-only, zero attachments, demo feedback, focus and preserved values`);

    await page.locator('#contact-email').fill('');
    await page.locator('#contact-phone').fill('(215) 555-0126');
    await page.locator('#contact-zip').fill('123');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send Message', exact: true }).click();
    assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement.id), 'contact-zip');
    await page.locator('#contact-zip').fill('19103-1234');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send Message', exact: true }).click();
    await page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Demo complete.' }).waitFor();
    await page.waitForTimeout(100);
    assert.equal(demoLogs.length, 2);
    assert.equal(demoLogs[1].phone, '(215) 555-0126');
    check(`${browserName}: phone-only and ZIP validation`);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Back to Form' }).click();

    const picker = page.locator('.photo-picker input[type="file"]');
    await picker.setInputFiles(fileData());
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.photo-picker__file').count(), 1);
    await picker.setInputFiles(fileData());
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.photo-picker__file').count(), 1);
    await picker.setInputFiles(fileData('bad.pdf', 'application/pdf'));
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.photo-picker__file').count(), 1);
    assert(await page.locator('#contact-photos-error').isVisible());
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send Message', exact: true }).click();
    assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement.id), 'contact-photos');
    assert.equal(demoLogs.length, 2);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Dismiss file error' }).click();
    await picker.setInputFiles(fileData('big.png', 'image/png', photoRules.maxBytes + 1));
    assert((await page.locator('#contact-photos-error').textContent()).includes('10 MB'));
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Dismiss file error' }).click();
    await picker.setInputFiles(Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, i) => fileData(`extra-${i}.png`)));
    assert((await page.locator('#contact-photos-error').textContent()).includes('5 images'));
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.photo-picker__file').count(), 1);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Dismiss file error' }).click();
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Remove roof.png', exact: true }).click();
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.photo-picker__file').count(), 0);
    await picker.setInputFiles(fileData());
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.photo-picker__file').count(), 1);
    check(`${browserName}: optional local files, duplicates, invalid type, excess size/count, remove and reselect`);

    await page.locator('.photo-picker__dropzone').evaluate((element) => {
      const dataTransfer = new DataTransfer();
      dataTransfer.items.add(new File(['image'], 'flashing.webp', { type: 'image/webp' }));
      element.dispatchEvent(new DragEvent('dragover', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, dataTransfer }));
      element.dispatchEvent(new DragEvent('drop', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, dataTransfer }));
    });
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.photo-picker__file').count(), 2);
    await page.locator('#contact-service').selectOption('roof-replacement');
    await page.locator('#contact-message').fill('Please review my roof.');
    await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(out, `${browserName}-files-selected.png`), fullPage: true });
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send Message', exact: true }).click();
    await page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Demo complete.' }).waitFor();
    await page.waitForTimeout(100);
    assert.equal(demoLogs[2].photos.length, 2);
    assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(demoLogs[2].photos[0]).sort(), ['lastModified', 'name', 'size', 'type']);
    assert.equal(demoLogs[2].serviceLabel, 'Roof Replacement');
    check(`${browserName}: file drop, service selection and metadata-only console payload`);

    await ready(page, `${base}/gallery`);
    await page.locator('.project-card__open').first().click();
    await page.locator('.project-dialog[open]').waitFor();
    const projectTitle = (await page.locator('.project-dialog__title').textContent()).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    await page.locator('.project-dialog__cta').click();
    await page.waitForURL('**/contact');
    await page.locator('#contact-message').waitFor();
    assert((await page.locator('#contact-message').inputValue()).includes('Standing-Seam'));
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.body.style.position !== 'fixed');
    await page.locator('#contact-message').fill('My own edited message.');
    await page.locator('#contact-name').fill('Gallery visitor');
    assert.equal(await page.locator('#contact-message').inputValue(), 'My own edited message.');
    await page.locator('#contact-email').fill('visitor@example.com');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send Message', exact: true }).click();
    await page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Demo complete.' }).waitFor();
    await page.waitForTimeout(100);
    assert.equal(demoLogs.at(-1).source.type, 'project');
    assert(demoLogs.at(-1).source.title.includes(projectTitle.split(' ')[0]));
    check(`${browserName}: real Gallery-to-Contact transition, context and editable message`);

    await ready(page, `${base}/blog`);
    await page.locator('.article-row__open').first().click();
    await page.locator('.article-dialog[open]').waitFor();
    await page.locator('.article-dialog__cta').click();
    await page.waitForURL('**/contact');
    await page.locator('#contact-message').waitFor();
    assert((await page.locator('#contact-message').inputValue()).includes('Getting Your Roof Ready for Winter'));
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.body.style.position !== 'fixed');
    check(`${browserName}: real Blog-to-Contact transition and article context`);

    await ready(page, `${base}/contact#contact-form`);
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.activeElement.id === 'contact-name');
    await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
    assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement.id), 'contact-zip');
    check(`${browserName}: direct form anchor and keyboard tab order`);

    await ready(page, 'http://127.0.0.1:4193/contact');
    await page.locator('#contact-name').fill('Strict Mode');
    await page.locator('#contact-email').fill('strict@example.com');
    const before = demoLogs.length;
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send Message', exact: true }).click();
    await page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Demo complete.' }).waitFor();
    await page.waitForTimeout(150);
    assert.equal(demoLogs.length, before + 1);
    check(`${browserName}: StrictMode submits once`);
    assert.deepEqual(errors, []);
    assert.deepEqual(submissions, []);
    assert.deepEqual(external, []);
    check(`${browserName}: no runtime errors, POSTs or third-party requests`);

    const phoneContext = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 }, hasTouch: true, isMobile: true });
    const phone = await phoneContext.newPage();
    await ready(phone);
    await phone.locator('#contact-name').fill('Mobile visitor');
    await phone.locator('#contact-email').fill('mobile@example.com');
    await phone.getByRole('button', { name: 'Send Message', exact: true }).tap();
    await phone.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Demo complete.' }).waitFor();
    await phone.getByRole('button', { name: 'Back to Form' }).tap();
    assert.equal(await phone.locator('#contact-name').inputValue(), 'Mobile visitor');
    await phoneContext.close();
    check(`${browserName}: touch viewport submits without files and returns`);
  } catch (error) {
    report.failures.push({ browser: browserName, message: String(error), stack: error.stack });
    try { await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(out, `${browserName}-failure.png`), fullPage: true }); } catch {}
  } finally {
    await browser.close();
  }
}
await fs.writeFile(path.join(out, 'report.json'), JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
console.log(JSON.stringify({ checks: report.checks.length, failures: report.failures, layouts: report.layouts.length, assets: report.assets }, null, 2));
if (report.failures.length) process.exitCode = 1;
